originals.why: Natural North Welsh. 'mae hi'n mynd yn hwyr' is the usual way to say 'it's getting late', and it joins cleanly to the LEGO with ond.

originals.ko: 그녀는 밤늦게 귀 기울이지 않을 거야
originals.why: Grammatical and idiomatic. The LEGO keeps the sense this course taught, 'she won't listen', and gwrando'n hwyr yn y nos reads naturally.

originals.ko: 나는 모든 말에 귀 기울이지 않을 것 같아
originals.why: Natural conditional, 'I wouldn't listen to every word'. ar bob gair keeps the same sense this course taught.
